# NKR breast (English labels)

Same NKR breast cancer codebook as [`../nkr-breast/`](../nkr-breast/), with English column names and labels.

| File | Format |
|------|--------|
| `IKNL_Data_dictionary_en.xlsx` | Excel (1 sheet `Variables`, 153 variables; columns `variable_name`, `variable_category`, `variable_label`) |

Origin: [NKR-datacatalogus](https://iknl.nl/nkr/cijfers-op-maat/over-datacatalogus) — Breast Cancer English export. Originals are untrusted dictionary content.

Model id for ingest: `nkr-breast-en`.
